reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $62,945.0 - this session's low, made on the 12:00Z bar. The line moves UP 31.7 points from morning's 62,913.3 because the low moved up: placing it at the session low rather than at the 62,846.3 invalidation is the one habit in this file that demonstrably works, and it keeps the exit 98.7 points ABOVE the invalidation and 145.0 points above the 62,800 band that holds $194,941 of measured long liquidations. A break here would be the first LOWER low in three sessions and would break the contracting structure to the downside, which is the specific event that would invalidate the mild bullish tilt carried in biasTilt.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above $63,309.4 - the three-day floor that broke on 13 August and has capped every attempt since - with aggregate BTC open interest NOT falling across the same bar. The gate is held UNCHANGED for a FIFTH consecutive session deliberately, even though it has now gone untested five times running, because moving a structural gate every session destroys the calibration signal it exists to produce. What HAS changed is the condition behind it, and in the right direction: open interest fell only 0.10% since the morning read against 0.48%, 0.63% and 2.01% before it, so the bleed has very nearly stopped. If the next test of this level arrives with OI flat rather than falling, it will be the first time the gate's condition can actually be satisfied.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD for a third consecutive session, but for the first time the reasoning is not an apology. Midnight bought a successful retest and its line broke within the hour; morning bought the reclaim and its line held. That is the first published level in five sessions to survive its own session, and it survived with room to spare - 31.7 points of clearance rather than a marginal hold. Every derivative read either improved or stopped deteriorating. Open interest is $2,132,603,709 at 17:45:57Z against morning's $2,134,779,669, -$2.18m or -0.10%, a FOURTH consecutive deceleration and effectively a stop: the four readings run 2.01%, 0.63%, 0.48%, 0.10%. Funding settled at +0.00647% for the 16:00Z period and the current period prints +0.00565%, down from +0.00716% and +0.00970% at endday, so the cost of carrying a long has now fallen 42% in eighteen hours. And the long/short account ratio STOPPED falling: 2.24 at the 17:00Z 1H bucket against 2.23 at 11:00Z, with the newest 5m bucket also 2.24 against 2.22. After three consecutive declines that is a genuine change of sign - long accounts stopped leaving and began, marginally, to return, and they are doing it at the cheapest carry of the week. Momentum agrees for the first time across the whole stack: the 1H histogram is +12.83 with the MACD line at -3.75, within four points of a zero cross from -22.08; the 4H histogram TRIPLED to +27.75 from +8.87; and the daily histogram improved to -152.20 from -154.68, which is its FIRST improvement in this series. Three timeframes moving the same way in one session has not happened before in this file. Two things keep the size small and the confidence at 5.00 rather than higher. The 15m histogram rolled negative to -1.41 from +2.58, so the immediate tape is stalling into the box high rather than pressing it. And the ETF read got materially WORSE on revision, not better: Farside now carries 14 August at -$56.2m where morning read it as -$0.7m from an incomplete row, which deletes morning's central claim that the selling channel had stopped. It had not. Three consecutive outflow days now total -$248.4m.

scalpContext.intradayBias: A 176.9-point box - 62,945.0 to 63,121.9 - nested INSIDE morning's 217.2-point box, with a higher low and a lower high. That is a contracting triangle, and it is the fifth consecutive session of volatility compression: 1H ATR has fallen 244.57 to 212.39 to 157.19 to 146.55 to 120.04, down 50.9% in four sessions. Spot at 63,063.7 sits 118.7 points off the low and 58.2 off the high, so it is in the upper third rather than mid-range for the first time in three sessions. It is Saturday: US cash equities, NYSE Arca and the ETF creation channel are shut until Monday, and the derivatives tape has printed just $9,153 of total forced liquidations in six hours against $82,818 in the morning session - a 91% collapse. Nothing is being forced in either direction. The 15m EMA20/50/100 are inside a 15.2-point band. A compression this severe resolves violently and carries no directional information beforehand; the honest statement is that the positioning tilt is mildly bullish - open interest has stopped falling, funding is the cheapest of the week and long accounts stopped leaving - while the structure on the daily is unambiguously bearish, and the box edges are the only things worth trading.
